import re, glob, os

inputs_dir = '/inputs'
files = [f for f in os.listdir(inputs_dir) if f != 'README.md' and re.search(r'-.*\.md$', f) and f.endswith('.md') and '-' in f]
# glob *-*.md properly
import fnmatch
matched = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(inputs_dir) if fnmatch.fnmatch(f, '*-*.md') and f != 'README.md')
print(matched)

titles = {}
for f in matched:
    with open(os.path.join(inputs_dir, f), encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    m = re.search(r'^#\s+(.*)$', content, re.MULTILINE)
    title = m.group(1).strip() if m else ''
    titles[f] = title
    print(f, '->', title)
